finding.claim: Negative numbers formatted as hexadecimal/binary/octal produce invalid literals like 0x-A instead of -0xA because the sign from toString(radix) is kept after the prefix.
finding.title: Negative hex/bin/oct number prefix produces invalid literal

verifier.reason: The branch at jsesc.js:216-225 builds '0x' + argument.toString(16), '0b' + argument.toString(2), and '0o' + argument.toString(8) without moving the leading '-' before the prefix, so e.g. (-10).toString(16)='-a' yields '0x-a'/'0x-A', and the result is returned directly at jsesc.js:228-231.

finding.claim: If options.numbers is not decimal/hexadecimal/binary/octal, inner result stays undefined and the function returns undefined (or 'undefinedn' for BigInt) instead of a string.
finding.title: Unknown numbers option returns undefined instead of string

verifier.reason: The excerpt at jsesc.js:213-231 shows a conditional chain with no else and a subsequent return of the inner result, but the definitions of useDecNumbers/useHexNumbers/useBinNumbers/useOctNumbers and any defaulting or validation of options.numbers are not in the provided excerpts, so it cannot be settled whether an unknown numbers value makes all four flags false.

finding.claim: The second isBigInt branch can never execute because the preceding branch already matches isNumber OR isBigInt, making it dead code.
finding.title: Unreachable BigInt branch after combined number check

verifier.reason: The else-if at jsesc.js:203 matches isNumber(argument) || isBigInt(argument), so reaching jsesc.js:232 requires that condition to be false and therefore isBigInt(argument) to be false with no intervening code, making the second isBigInt branch unreachable.

repro.reason: Dead code has no observable behavioral effect: the branch at line 203 (isNumber || isBigInt) already handles every BigInt input, including JSON conversion and decimal/hexadecimal/binary/octal formatting with the 'n' suffix at lines 228-230, identically or more correctly than the unreachable branch at line 232. No input can produce different correct output by reaching the second branch, so a faithful execution test asserting correct BigInt behavior would pass on this commit; demonstrating the finding requires static reachability analysis, not a runtime reproducer.
